en-US.description: Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust.
An open-source, clean-room take on the Adobe Premiere Pro workflow: native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly. By the ArtCraft team.
Premiere 26's full Video Effects bin (93 effects in 16 folders), the Legacy bin and the obsolete effects old projects use, plus around 30 transitions.
en-US.name: FilmCraft
en-US.releaseNotes:
Note
FreeBSD aarch64 is dropped from this release. We had to cut releases, and we cannot build this target within the 5-hour CI limit for any of the Craft apps, so we are dropping it for now. This is a known blocker, flagged for a future fix in storytold/craft-common-actions#39. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included.
What's Changed
- Reject TTML offset times that have no integer digits by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2753
- Speak the minus sign of negative currency amounts in TTS normalizer by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2756
- Keep file URL hosts that only start with "localhost" by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2757
- Read the a of a.m. and attached am as the letter name A by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2832
- dev_icon: write the MimeType line the packaged .desktop file has by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2572
Full Changelog: https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/compare/v0.11.0...v0.12.0

zh-CN.description: 视频剪辑、调色与声音；以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Premiere Pro 净室重实现
zh-CN.longDescription:
视频剪辑、调色与声音；一个以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Premiere Pro 净室重实现。
对 Adobe Premiere Pro 工作流的开源净室重现：macOS、Windows 和 Linux 原生应用，并可通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中使用。由 ArtCraft 团队打造。
包含 Premiere 26 的完整视频效果箱（16 个文件夹中的 93 种效果）、传统效果箱和旧项目使用的过时效果，以及约 30 种转场。
